meta.move: Evidence: the made-up quotation, with a check she can make
meta.expect: Tries one parent defence in one sentence (misremembered, a bad edition), then accepts that a line she can check against the play is evidence; no concession that Owen cheated

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. Who decided on that zero, and why did my son find out from his phone in the middle of class?
I entered the zero before I called you. That was wrong.
Okay. Now tell me on what basis.
The essay quotes Hamlet, Act 3, Scene 2: The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile. That line is not in the play. Here's the full text of Act 3, Scene 2 on my screen. Search it yourself.
Turn it toward me, Hale. I'm writing down the line exactly as you read it. Seventeen-year-olds get act and scene numbers wrong every day, so how do you know it isn't just in a different scene?
It isn't a misremembered line. It isn't anywhere in Hamlet, in any edition. You can search the whole play right now.
I'll search it myself tonight, and I'm writing down that you said any edition. Whatever happens from here, Hale, this stays off Owen's record and it stays quiet. Is anything on his file right now?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require that this stay off Owen's record and stay quiet, and that the zero come off. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: fallback position, having agreed to nothing, and she still wants this kept off Owen's record and kept quiet, plus an answer on whether anything is on his file now; the fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, which was not reached because the meeting ended early, not because her time ran out.
What moved her: Hale pointed to a quotation in the essay that does not exist in the play and let her search the full text herself, then answered her misquote defence, because that was specific, tied to Owen's own work, and something she could check.
What cost ground: nothing, since Hale owned the early zero in one sentence and stayed on the document.
What she never said: in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; Hale's evidence never came near that night, since no times or late-night details were raised; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: right after she asked whether anything was on his file, answer no and commit to procedure 4.4, a first concern with a supervised reassessment whose mark replaces the zero and nothing in his record, which meets her fallback and opens the way to the rewrite.
